initialBuild.title: Journeyman
initialBuild.description:
## Beginner

max happy dude along with lucky clover, for better exp gain. Equally place points into the three other stats for efficiency in all skills

## Journeyman

max lucky horseshoe, along with the curse of looty mc booty. also max fabrics for even more luck, if you aren't getting enough exp. put *1 excess points into card drops and rare drops, and *2 excess points into its your birthday.

misc: make sure to always use the EXP big bubble for even more exp.
